ownership: Pinned SwWrtShell Insert/SplitNode and DelLeft/DelRight call actual native shell, cursor, document and history owners. SwTransferable::Paste/PasteData accept actual SwWrtShell& and coordinate native insertion; synthetic editing and clipboard callback ports have no corresponding native lifetime owner.
change: Removed SwWrtShellEditingPort, SwWrtShellEditingOperations and WriterPasteOperations. Eight structural algorithms accept actual native shell with type-only dependency. Transfer and list history use actual shell; initial operation receives real undo context from SwWrtShell.ApplyAction. No new editing object, callback object, forwarding shim or TextRuns conversion.
representation: Source split remains a filename responsibility exception under1000-line gate. Existing clipboard/filter DTOs, Unicode/grapheme adaptation and native action payloads remain represented behavior; this task does not claim full native insertion/clipboard/mode parity.
proof: 482 unchanged existing tests, one absent full profile, actual shell/mounted/browser text/table/list/history/composition/transfer coverage and dependency-cycle check.
residual: Complete native layout/protection/selection modes, clipboard format import/export, complex merged/nested/frame table behavior, native action hierarchy and whole-core/UI upstream parity remain unverified.
